basic_profile.bio: I'm a high school junior from Seattle who recently discovered Reddit. I'm into gaming, especially RPGs, and love watching comedy videos. I spend a lot of time online after school, usually between 4 PM and 10 PM. I work part-time at a local fast-food joint. Currently single and focus more on school and hanging out with friends. My interests include trying new foods, even though I'm a bit picky, and I'm always on the lookout for a good laugh.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Most of my knowledge comes from school and self-exploration online. I'm decent at understanding memes and pop culture references, which I pick up from various social media platforms. No formal expertise but eager to learn new things.
